name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
stance: Pushes transparency, independent testing and human oversight before AI is deployed in safety-critical systems; a member of the Congressional AI Caucus.

statements.text: Washington’s refusal to regulate AI is a corruption story.

Now, this is the seventh hearing we've had this year on the threats of AI. Yet our Congress has passed zero pieces of legislation to address the many, many legitimate concerns that have been raised regarding this issue.

And because Republicans couldn't pass their ten-year ban on state AI regulations, Trump then went around and skirted Congress with his own executive order, trying to ban states from imposing any AI regulations at all
Co-led a letter urging the FAA to pause its AI-enabled 'SMART' air-traffic-control tool until safety-testing, transparency and human-oversight questions are answered.
This administration may treat Big Tech companies with impunity, but air traffic control leaves zero margin for error,

Urged the FAA, with Rep. April McClain Delaney, to stop the rollout of a new AI air traffic control tool in Washington, DC until it answers questions about its safety evaluation and labor consultation.
